global_identity.color_palette: Native interface colors: light warm cream paper background #FBF3DC; near-black #111111 for the title and list; mid grey for the date; metallic gold #C9A441 for the back chevron, the 'Notas' label, the bar icons and the checkmarks; translucent lemon yellow #F2DC4A for the highlighter stroke; amber brown #8A4B14 (bottle glass) and warm wood and cream tones inside the attached photo.
global_identity.visual_style: Flat native phone-screenshot look plus one casual, well-lit smartphone photo. No people.
global_identity.visual_atmosphere: Light, warm, intimate and trustworthy; feels like a private note, not an ad.
global_identity.graphic_language: Flat UI with thin line icons, round checkboxes, one uneven hand-drawn highlighter stroke, one rounded-corner photo.
global_identity.text_typography: System sans-serif throughout (San Francisco / Roboto style): bold for the note title, regular for the list, small regular grey for the date, small semibold for the status-bar time. Sentence case, left-aligned. No uppercase headline, no outlines and no drop shadows.

creative_objective: Create curiosity by looking like the private phone note of a woman who decided to gain weight in a healthy way: her short morning list, with the drops highlighted and a casual photo of the bottle on her nightstand. Preserve the exact structure of the format: status bar, notes navigation bar, bold note title, grey date line, a list of five checkbox items with one highlighter stroke, and one attached rounded-corner photo at the bottom.

art_direction.design_quality: Premium, polished, modern, scroll-stopping, professionally designed, commercially strong
art_direction.visual_hierarchy: 1) The bold note title at the top of the note. 2) The short list, read top to bottom, with the highlighted second item. 3) The attached photo of the bottle at the bottom. 4) Discreet app chrome that sells the native look.
art_direction.composition_style: Full-bleed flat UI screenshot with no device frame and no perspective: the canvas IS the phone screen, cropped to a square. A strict single column aligned to one common left margin. The attached photo spans the full content width at the bottom and is the only image on the canvas.
art_direction.spacing_and_structure: Status bar y 0-4%. Navigation bar y 4-10%. Note title in two lines y 12-22%. Date line y 23-26%. List y 28-56% (5 single-line items, even line spacing). Attached photo y 59-95%, full content width (x 6-94%). Left and right margins 6%. Nothing outside these zones.
art_direction.lighting_and_depth: Flat, evenly lit digital interface with no shadows, gradients or 3D effects. Only the attached photo has real-world lighting: soft morning window daylight, casual smartphone-camera look with mild depth of field.
art_direction.conversion_feel: The ad must feel persuasive, eye-catching, emotionally engaging, credible, elegant and commercially strong

reference_structure_analysis.layout_summary: Square crop of a generic smartphone notes app in light mode on a light cream paper background. A minimal status bar at the very top (time on the left, generic signal, wifi and battery glyphs on the right). Below it, a navigation bar with a back chevron and the word 'Notas' in gold on the left, and generic share and three-dot icons in gold on the right. Then the note: a bold two-line title, a small grey date line, a list of five single-line items each preceded by a round checkbox, with a translucent lemon-yellow hand-drawn highlighter stroke over the second item, and a rounded-corner casual photo of the bottle on a nightstand attached at the bottom.

visual_prompt: Square 1:1 image that is a flat, full-bleed screenshot of a generic smartphone notes app in light mode, with no device frame, no hands and no perspective: the canvas itself is the phone screen. BACKGROUND: flat light warm-cream paper tone (#FBF3DC, slightly lighter), with at most an ultra-subtle paper grain; no gradients. STATUS BAR (y 0-4%): a small dark-grey semibold time at the top left; small generic dark-grey signal, wifi and battery glyphs at the top right; no carrier name, no notch. NAVIGATION BAR (y 4-10%): at the left, a back chevron followed by the word for the notes list, both in metallic gold (#C9A441), regular weight; at the right, two generic thin line icons in the same gold: a share icon and a three-dot 'more' icon. No app name or real app logo. NOTE BODY, everything aligned to one common left margin at 6%: a bold near-black (#111111) system sans-serif note title in two lines (y 12-22%); directly under it, a small mid-grey date line (y 23-26%); then a list of five single-line items in regular near-black system sans-serif with even, airy line spacing (y 28-56%), each preceded by a small round checkbox filled in gold with a white checkmark. Over the text of the SECOND list item only, a single translucent lemon-yellow (#F2DC4A) highlighter stroke, slightly uneven like a finger or stylus mark, with the text under it fully legible. No numbers, emojis or icons beside the items, no keyboard, no text cursor. ATTACHED PHOTO (x 6-94%, y 59-95%), with rounded corners: a casual but well-lit smartphone photo taken from above at an angle, in soft morning window light with mild depth of field, of the product standing on a light wooden nightstand, centered in the photo with its label clearly visible, filling about 65% of the photo's height; beside it a glass of water and a cream hair tie, and the edge of cream bed linen softly out of focus behind. No text or graphics inside the photo other than the product's own label. The product is a 60 ml (2 fl oz) amber-brown glass dropper bottle with rounded shoulders and a short neck, topped with a black ribbed screw collar and a glossy black rubber bulb dropper; the glass pipette is visible inside the amber liquid. A wraparound label covers most of the body with a smooth vertical gradient from bright lemon yellow at the top to white / pale silver at the bottom. On the label, from top to bottom: the lowercase black wordmark 'amua', the large white uppercase name 'VITALDROPS', a small dark line 'All-In-One Multi-Herbal Supplement', five small thin-outlined circular ingredient badges in two rows (A, MA, L on the first row; F, BR on the second) with tiny captions, and 'Dietary Supplement 2 fl. oz. (60mL)' at the bottom. The bottle is roughly 2.6 times taller than wide including the dropper. Use the attached product image as the only source of truth for the product; do not redesign, replace or reinterpret the bottle or its label. Nothing else on the canvas: no ad headline outside the note, no button, no price, no stars, no stickers, no second photo, no extra text.
